_readme: Known symbols for ES1's GO.EXE (ES1GO): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: X32_AllocMemory
entries.description: (size), C convention: ES1DBSIM's X32_AllocMemory (000001d7), its high-water mark at 0007d554 and EDX stored at 0007d550. Rounds size up to a multiple of 0x1000 and asks the extender for it (INT 21h AX=350Ch); returns the block's address, or -1 on carry.

entries.name: __x386_coproc_init
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_coproc_init`, from `x386.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 86 bytes from here.

entries.name: Heap_Ctor
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: the heap object's constructor. With a null this it allocates 0x10 bytes through operator_new and returns 0 if that fails. Stores the address 000aa24a at 000aa24a. Returns the global heap 0009a308 untouched; any other heap gets its four dwords zeroed.

entries.name: Heap_Init
entries.description: (heap, block, size), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Init without the low mark: +0 base, +4 the size as given, +8 the free list (the block, its link zeroed), +0xc and the block's own size the size rounded down to a multiple of 8, and FBLK at the block's +8.

entries.name: Heap_IsAllocated
entries.description: (heap, payload): 1 when the payload lies from the heap's base to its end (+0 + +4) and its header (payload - 8) holds ABLK, else 0.

entries.name: Heap_IsBlock
entries.description: (heap, block header): ES1DBSIM's Heap_IsBlock. 1 when the address lies from the heap's base to 0x10 bytes before its end and carries FBLK at +8 or ABLK at +0, else 0.

entries.name: Heap_IsValidAllocation
entries.description: (heap, payload): 0 unless Heap_IsAllocated. Then 1 when the block's end (header + size) equals the heap's base plus 8 times the dword at +4, which Heap_Init sets to the size in bytes; otherwise Heap_IsBlock on the block's own header.

entries.name: Heap_LargestFree
entries.description: (heap): the largest size on the free list less the 8-byte header. Reads the list's head without testing it for null.

entries.name: Heap_Alloc
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Alloc without the trackLow argument and the low mark. First fit on (size + 8) rounded up to 8: an exact block is unlinked, one more than 0x10 bytes larger is split with the tail left free (FBLK); tags the block ABLK, zero-fills the payload, takes the size off +0xc and returns the payload. 0 for size 0 or when nothing fits.

entries.name: Heap_Free
entries.description: (heap, payload), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Free. Nothing for null; otherwise adds the size back to +0xc, tags the block FBLK, inserts it into the free list in address order and merges it with touching free neighbours.

entries.name: Heap_Realloc
entries.description: (heap, size, payload), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Realloc with its branches inverted and returning early, and without the low mark. Size 0 frees; a smaller size gives the tail to a following free block, frees it as its own block when over 0x10 bytes, or moves the data; a larger size takes it from a following free block that has room, or moves the data. Calls Heap_IsBlock, Heap_FindPrevFree, Heap_Alloc, Heap_Free and memmove.

entries.name: Heap_DrawMap
entries.description: (heap, rows, columns, top, left), callee-cleaned (RET 0x14): divides the heap's +4 size into rows x columns equal shares and walks the global heap 0009a308's blocks with HeapIter_Init and HeapIter_Next, working out for each cell the share of its bytes in ABLK blocks. Each cell is passed to 0004f904 with left + column, top + row, 0007d7b0 and a character by that share: 7 for none, 0xb1 below 50%, 0xb2 below 100% and 0xdb for all.

entries.name: Heap_FindPrevFree
entries.description: (heap, block): ES1DBSIM's Heap_FindPrevFree. The free block whose link is the given block; 0 when it heads the list or the walk ends.

entries.name: HeapIter_Init
entries.description: (this, heap), callee-cleaned: a two-dword heap walker. With a null this it allocates 8 bytes through operator_new and returns 0 if that fails. Stores the heap at +0 and the heap's base, its first block, at +4.

entries.name: HeapIter_Next
entries.description: (walker), callee-cleaned: returns 0 when the walker's block (+4) is 0. Otherwise steps +4 on by the block's size, sets it to 0 when that reaches the heap's base plus size, and returns the new +4.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): ES1DBSIM's Mem_InitHeap with the cap at X32_LargestFreeBlock() - 15000: takes the block from X32_AllocMemory, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (src\memory.cpp line 494, severity 5) through Assert_Report when that returns -1, makes it the heap 0009a308 (Heap_Init) and sets 0007d7b4.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: Clears 0007d7b4, after which operator new and malloc take memory from X32_AllocMemory and the frees do nothing.

entries.name: operator_new
entries.description: The program's operator new (size), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Alloc(0009a308, size) while 0007d7b4 is set, otherwise X32_AllocMemory(size) with -1 returned as 0.

entries.name: Mem_AllocFromHeap
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned (RET 8): Heap_Alloc(heap, size) on the heap it is given.

entries.name: operator_delete
entries.description: The program's operator delete (pointer), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Free(0009a308, pointer) while 0007d7b4 is set, otherwise nothing.

entries.name: malloc
entries.description: The program's malloc (size), C convention: operator_new's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: free
entries.description: The program's free (pointer), C convention: operator_delete's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: realloc
entries.description: The program's realloc (pointer, size), C convention: Heap_Realloc(0009a308, size, pointer), whether or not 0007d7b4 is set.

entries.name: calloc
entries.description: The program's calloc (count, size), C convention: ES1DBSIM's calloc over the heap 0009a308 and flag 0007d7b4. Clears the block over the size in the header before it, which a block from X32_AllocMemory does not have.

entries.name: Mem_ConstructHeap
entries.description: No arguments, C convention: Heap_Ctor(0009a308), the global heap.

entries.name: VolRStream_Ctor
entries.description: VolRStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0x2f bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00083c16 at +4, clears the filters +0x27 and +0x2b and the entry fields +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, handle -1 at +8 and status 5 at +0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Ctor (00056710) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: VolRStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: VolRStream_Ctor's allocation and clearing, then adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0x26 = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_CtorFromHandle (00056760) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_CtorFromPath
entries.description: VolRStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x2f bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00083c16, clears +0x27, +0x2b, +0xa, +0xe, +0x16, handle -1, +0x26 cleared, then VolRStream_Open(path); the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_CtorFromPath (000567cc) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Dtor
entries.description: VolRStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 00083c16, deletes the filters at +0x27 and +0x2b through their own slot +4 with flags 3, VolRStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Dtor (00056824) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): VolRStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0x26 = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, VolRStream_SetIoError on -1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetFile (0005688c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0x26) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; passes the RLE filter +0x27 to 00064560 and the LZH filter +0x2b to 00065000 when set; clears +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, sets the handle to -1 and status 5, and returns 1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Close (000568d0) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): VolRStream_Close, clears +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, then open(path, 0) into the handle at +8. When that fails it looks the path up in the volume group 00083c04 through 0004dd96, which fills the entry fields from +0xa; with no group or no entry it sets status 1 and returns 0. By the entry's compression type at +0x1e it reads through: 2, the volume's stream itself (+0xe = +0xa); 7, the RLE filter at +0x27 (made by 00064460 on first use and attached by 0006452c); 9, the LZH filter at +0x2b (00064ec0, 00064fa4). Then status 0 and +0x26 = 1, also for a volume entry, and returns 1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Open (00056944) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetGroup
entries.description: (a, b, c, d): makes the volume group 00083c04 through 0004d82c(0, a, b, c, d) on first use, otherwise passes the same arguments to 0004d98f on it; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetGroup (00056a38) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_DeleteGroup
entries.description: (): when the volume group 00083c04 is set, 0004d89a(group, 3) and clears 00083c04. es2_xref finds one call, from main (00012ec7); the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_DeleteGroup (00056a7c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_LoadVolume
entries.description: (path): passes the path to 0004dcf7 on the volume group 00083c04; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_LoadVolume (00056aa0) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_GetSize
entries.description: (stream): filelength of the handle at +8 when there is one, otherwise the entry size +0x22 when an entry is open (+0xe), else 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_GetSize (00056ab8) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_GetPosition
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +8 (stream): lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR) for a file handle, the position in the entry (+0x16) when one is open, else 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_GetPosition (00056b00) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetPosition
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0xc (stream, position): a status of 2 is cleared first, and any other nonzero status returns 0. A file handle seeks with lseek(h, position, SEEK_SET), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1. An open entry stores the position at +0x16 and at +0x1a the absolute offset +0x12 + position, or, when the position is not below the size +0x22, the size itself with status 2; type 2 seeks the volume stream there, and types 7 and 9 reset their filter (00064560, 00065000), seek the volume stream to the entry's start, re-attach the filter (0006452c, 00064fa4) and seek the filter to the position. Returns 1 otherwise; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetPosition (00056b4c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): for a file handle, query 0 answers 2 and queries 2 and 3 answer 1; for a volume entry, query 0 answers the compression type +0x1e, 2 and 3 answer 1 and 4 answers whether the type is not 2. Anything else answers 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_GetCapabilities (00056cc4) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Flush
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x14: loads this into ECX, MOV AL,1; RET 4; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Flush (00056d2c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetIoError
entries.description: (stream): sets the status at +0 to 3 when errno (00083cbf) is 0, otherwise 1, and returns 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetIoError (00056d34) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Write
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x18: loads its three arguments into registers, sets status 4 and returns 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Write (00056d5c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Read
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x1c (stream, buffer, count): 0 when the status is nonzero, 1 for a count of 0. A file handle reads through read(), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1 and status 2 with 0 returned on a short read. An entry first re-seeks (slot +0xc to +0x16) when the volume stream's position no longer equals +0x1a. A read running past the entry size +0x22 sets status 2, reads size - position + 1 bytes from the volume stream at +0xa itself, sets +0x16 to size + 1 and returns 0; any other reads count bytes through +0xe (the volume stream or the filter), adds count to +0x16 and returns 1. Both update +0x1a to the volume stream's position; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Read (00056d70) in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_Ctor
entries.description: VolumeGroup constructor, callee-cleaned, (this, dirFirst, dir, extension, mask) in stack order: allocates 0x29 bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), clears the 10 volume pointers at +0 and the count byte +0x28, sets VolumeGroup_BufferSize (00083c64) to 0x400, then VolumeGroup_SetGroup with the same arguments, and returns this. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_Ctor (00056180), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_Dtor
entries.description: VolumeGroup destructor (this, flags): returns at once for a null this; otherwise 0004ca93(volume, 3) on each of the count (+0x28) volume pointers, and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. The class stores no vptr. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_Dtor (000561d8), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_SetBufferSize
entries.description: (size), callee-cleaned: stores max(size, 0x80) in VolumeGroup_BufferSize (00083c64). es2_xref finds one call, from main (00012ec7), with 0x200 just before main calls VolRStream_SetGroup; when that call makes the group, VolumeGroup_Ctor stores 0x400 over it before any volume is loaded. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_SetBufferSize (00056238), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: Path_JoinSkipDrive
entries.description: (name, dir) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies dir, or the empty string at 00083c68 when it is null, into the static buffer 000a0b84, appends name without a leading 'X:' drive prefix and returns the buffer. ES1DBSIM's Path_JoinSkipDrive (00056254), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: Path_SkipDrive
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: returns path + 2 when path[1] is ':', else path. ES1DBSIM's Path_SkipDrive (000562bc), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_SetGroup
entries.description: (group, dirFirst, dir, extension, mask) in stack order, callee-cleaned: walks the volumes by index and removes one whose flags (+0x20) share no bit with mask through VolumeGroup_RemoveVolume, then moves on past the volume shifted into its slot; returns when the group holds 10 volumes, then scans Str_Concat4's [dir]'vol\*'<extension> with findfirst and findnext twice, with dir the first time only when dirFirst is nonzero and the second time only when it is 0. Each file whose 'vol\<name>' equals no loaded volume's name (+8, through Path_SkipDrive) is added with VolumeGroup_AddVolume(group, mask, Path_JoinSkipDrive('vol\<name>', that pass's dir)). The count is tested once, before the scans. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_SetGroup (000562d8), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_RemoveVolume
entries.description: (group, index): 0004ca93(volume, 3) on the volume at index, shifts the later pointers down one while they are set, decrements the count byte +0x28 and clears the freed last slot. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_RemoveVolume (00056528), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_AddVolume
entries.description: (group, mask, path) in stack order: 0004cb1c(VolumeGroup_BufferSize, mask, path) in stack order, and when that returns a volume, inserts it so the list stays in descending order of the byte at volume +0x1c, then increments the count byte +0x28. It does not test the count. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_AddVolume (000565a4), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_LoadVolume
entries.description: (group, path): returns 0 for a null path or a group of 10 volumes; otherwise, unless a loaded volume's name (+8) equals path, VolumeGroup_AddVolume(group, 0xffffffff, path); returns 1. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_LoadVolume (00056620), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_FindEntry
entries.description: (group, entry, path) in stack order: 0004ce15(volume, entry, path) on each volume in order (count byte +0x28), returning 1 at the first that answers nonzero, else 0. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_FindEntry (000566b8), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: read
entries.description: The runtime's read (handle, buffer, count), C convention: MOV AH,3Fh ahead of its frame, then INT 21h with the handle in EBX, the buffer in EDX and the count in ECX. Returns the count read; on carry stores the DOS error in errno (00083cbf) and returns -1, in the error exit at 0004ed4e that write (0004ed60) and open share. The copy of ES1DBSIM's read (00074910).

entries.name: Dos_ReadWrite
entries.description: The body read and write share, C convention (handle, buffer, count), entered with the DOS function already in AH: INT 21h with the handle in EBX, the buffer in EDX and the count in ECX. Returns the count transferred; on carry stores the DOS error in errno (00083cbf) and returns -1, in the error exit at 0004ed4e that open also jumps to. The copy of ES1DBSIM's Dos_ReadWrite (00074912).

entries.name: write
entries.description: The runtime's write (handle, buffer, count), C convention: MOV AH,40h and a jump into Dos_ReadWrite. The copy of ES1DBSIM's write (00074934).

entries.name: open
entries.description: The runtime's open (path, flags, mode), C convention: the copy of ES1DBSIM's open (00074947), errno at 00083cbf and the error exit at 0004ed4e.

entries.name: Assert_RunHooks
entries.description: (logger, severity), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Assert_RunHooks over the hook list at 000a0bd8 (+0 next, +4 the function), calling each with the severity.

entries.name: Assert_Report
entries.description: (logger, message, line, file, condition, severity) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Assert_Report without its debugger break. Severities 4, 5 and 6 run the hooks (Assert_RunHooks), emit the assert through 00000486, emit severity 1 and end the program through __exit(1); any other severity is only emitted through 00000486.

entries.name: X32_LargestFreeBlock
entries.description: No arguments, C convention: ES1DBSIM's X32_LargestFreeBlock, with the high-water mark at 0007d554 and the list headed at the pointer 0007d558. The larger of the extender's figure (INT 21h AX=350Bh) less the rest of the current 4 KB page and the largest size on that list, minus 4, or 0.

entries.name: FileRStream_CtorDefault
entries.description: FileRStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0xb bytes when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00086f8a at +4, handle -1 at +8, status 5 and +0xa (owns the handle) cleared. The copy of ES1DBSIM's FileRStream_CtorDefault (00065540).

entries.name: FileRStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: FileRStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00086f8a, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), FileRStream_SetIoError on -1. The copy of ES1DBSIM's FileRStream_CtorFromHandle (0006557c).

entries.name: FileRStream_Ctor
entries.description: FileRStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00086f8a, handle -1, +0xa cleared, then FileRStream_Open(path). The copy of ES1DBSIM's FileRStream_Ctor (000655d0).

entries.name: FileRStream_Dtor
entries.description: FileRStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 00086f8a, FileRStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. The copy of ES1DBSIM's FileRStream_Dtor (00065610).

entries.name: FileRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): query 0 answers 2, queries 2 and 3 answer 1, anything else 0. The copy of ES1DBSIM's FileRStream_GetCapabilities (00065648).

entries.name: FileRStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): FileRStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, FileRStream_SetIoError on -1. The copy of ES1DBSIM's FileRStream_SetFile (00065678).

entries.name: FileRStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0xa) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; otherwise sets the handle to -1 and status 5 and returns 1. The copy of ES1DBSIM's FileRStream_Close (000656bc).

entries.name: FileRStream_Open
